summary: Explain why metadata components are placed in deployment waves
description: Builds the same local plan used by start dry-run and explains wave placement, dependency edges, unresolved references, and provider-owned deployment decisions.
examples: <%= config.bin %> smart-deployment plan explain --use-ai --org-type Sandbox --target-org dev
flags.dry-run.summary: Accepted for parity with start dry-run; explain never deploys metadata
flags.validate-only.summary: Accepted for parity with start validate-only; explain never deploys metadata
flags.skip-tests.summary: Accepted for parity with start dry-run inputs; explain never runs tests
flags.allow-cycle-remediation.summary: Accepted for parity with start dry-run inputs; explain does not modify sources
flags.use-ai.summary: Use configured AI providers for dependency inference and wave priority analysis
flags.org-type.summary: Target org type used by AI wave priority analysis
flags.industry.summary: Industry context used by AI wave priority analysis
flags.since.summary: Git ref used to explain changed provider-owned metadata decisions
flags.auto-activate.summary: Include Agentforce activation decisions in provider-owned metadata planning
